This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|red]] skin and thin, elongated heads with large bluish-gray [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] situated on the sides. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], at least four members of this species could be found in the city [[Wrils]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]],<ref name="MJ1" /> while at least three others disembarked from a [[transport]] known as the ''[[Tippler's Groan]]'' onto the planet [[Phorliss]] shortly thereafter.<ref name="MJ4">[[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 4|''Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand'' 4]]</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==

Stackpole]], and illustrated by [[Carlos Ezquerra]].<ref name="MJ1" />
